subject: Re: Unexpected usage variance — request for per-session export and VAT handling
messages:
From: Elena Vasquez <elena@stridehealth.ai>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Stride Health Billing <billing@stridehealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Usage variance on Feb invoice (urgent)

Hi Aisha,

We reviewed our February invoice and there appears to be a ~42,000 token variance between what our internal logs show and the usage line on the invoice (line item: api.text.generate — 145,872 tokens billed). Our internal aggregator shows ~103k tokens for the same account and API key. That’s a $4.2k gap pre-tax.

Can you provide a per-session export (CSV) for the date range 2028-02-01 to 2028-02-28 with the following columns: session_id, request_id, model_variant, timestamp_utc, token_count, attribution_key? We need this to reconcile with our ingestion logs.

Also:
- We need a split of net vs VAT on the disputed tokens (we are EU VAT-registered but billing address shows the UK subsidiary).
- Can you hold collection on the disputed amount while this is under review? Our AP team is asking for a short hold and an adjusted invoice if needed.

Attached are three sample request_ids from our side that show much lower token counts than what appears on your invoice. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Elena Vasquez
Revenue Ops | Stride Health
elena@stridehealth.ai

Attachments: sample_request_ids.txt (3 lines)
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Elena Vasquez <elena@stridehealth.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage variance on Feb invoice (urgent)

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this and for the sample request IDs. We’ll pull the per-session export you requested and run a token-attribution check against your account. I’ve looped in Ben (sales lead), Marissa (billing ops) and David (finance) so we can coordinate the evidence and a proposal for next steps.

Two quick asks to help speed the reconciliation:
1) Can you confirm the account ID and the API key(s) you were using for Feb (we’ll match both api_key and attribution_key).
2) Do you have any scheduled bulk ingest jobs or test/staging keys that might have been used accidentally?

We’ll aim to get the export and a preliminary analysis back to you within 48 working hours. If we see an obvious attribution bug we can propose a provisional credit and place the disputed portion on hold pending your confirmation.

— Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Usage variance on Feb invoice (internal)

Internal note — possible quick checks:
- Sampling/window overlap: if a streaming session finished near the hourly boundary we’ve seen double-counting into both 'streaming' and 'async-ingest' paths before we've applied dedupe heuristics.
- Key reuse: staging key attributed to prod.

If we can’t find a clear misattribution, recommend offering a provisional credit equal to the difference between your audited export and invoice up to a cap (e.g., $1,500) while we run a full replay. That gives the customer breathing room with AP and preserves our ability to reconcile. Marissa / David: can you confirm how a provisional hold would be recorded and whether we can issue a one-time credit pending audit?

— Ben
Senior Account Lead, Redwood
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Elena Vasquez <elena@stridehealth.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage variance on Feb invoice (export + preliminary findings)

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick confirmation on account ID (ACCT-5882) and the three sample ids. Attached is the per-session export you requested (per_session_export_Mar01.csv). We also uploaded a compact replay of the disputed window to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-stride-export

Preliminary findings (summary):
- Total billed tokens on invoice (api.text.generate): 145,872
- Aggregate from your request logs (provided): ~103,200
- Per-session export (our attribution): 141,950 tokens.

Root cause candidate: a 90-minute backfill replay completed on 2028-02-14 02:00 UTC. That replay was tagged with an internal ingestion flag but, due to an edge-case in the allocator, ~38k tokens were attributed both to the replay pipeline and to live streaming sessions when request-level dedupe failed at an hourly boundary. This explains the delta and matches the timestamps on the sample_request_ids you sent.

Proposed remediation:
1) We can issue a provisional credit of $1,250 against the disputed line while we complete a full replay audit (expected by 2028-03-12).
2) Move the disputed amount ($4,200 pre-tax) to 'invoice on hold' status for 30 days to avoid AP collection actions. Our billing ops team will generate a redlined invoice showing the provisional adjustment and VAT split.
3) If the audit confirms the full double-attribution, we will issue a retroactive credit for the remainder and update your usage ledger.

Attachments: per_session_export_Mar01.csv (CSV export, 28k rows)

Let us know if Stride is ok with the provisional credit and invoice hold; we’ll proceed to issue the redline immediately.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Vasquez <elena@stridehealth.ai>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Stride Health Billing <billing@stridehealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage variance on Feb invoice (export + preliminary findings)

Hi Aisha — thank you for the quick analysis and for the export. We reviewed the Drive files and the sample matches what we see. Stride accepts the provisional credit of $1,250 and requests the following before the invoice is closed:
1) A redlined invoice showing the provisional credit and explicit VAT line for the disputed amount (we need VAT breakout for our reclaim).
2) Confirmation the disputed tokens will not be submitted to collections while the audit completes.

If you can send the redlined invoice today that would help our AP team (we will place payment for the undisputed portion once we have the updated invoice). Appreciate the follow-through.

Best,
Elena
Revenue Ops | Stride Health
